achievements.title: Free Points
achievements.description: Get a free sample courtesy of the Viridian City Pokémon Mart.

achievements.title: Parting Gift
achievements.description: Obtain 5 Poké Balls from Prof. Oak.

achievements.description: Find every item and defeat every trainer in Viridian Forest.

achievements.description: Without resetting, and without using Repels or Cut, get from one entrance of Viridian Forest to the other without initiating any wild encounters.

achievements.description: Defeat Brock and earn the Boulder Badge in Pewter City.

achievements.description: Defeat Brock on Set Mode without using items in battle and without using Pokémon above level 14 at the beginning of the battle.

achievements.description: Find every item and defeat every trainer in Mt. Moon.

achievements.title: Raindrop Cascade Badge

achievements.title: My Heart Will Go On
achievements.description: Collect every optional item and defeat every optional trainer on the S.S. Anne.

achievements.title: Flashing Lights Warning

achievements.title: Metal Detector

achievements.description: Defeat Lt. Surge on Set Mode without using items in battle and without using Pokémon above level 24 at the beginning of the battle.

achievements.title: I Like to Ride It
achievements.description: Obtain the Bicycle from the Bike Shop in Cerulean City.

achievements.title: Pleading Face
achievements.description: Find all the free coins in the Celadon City Game Corner.

achievements.title: Second Place Isn't Bad
achievements.description: Win a bar at the Celadon City Game Corner.

achievements.title: 7 Grand

achievements.title: So Rich...
achievements.description: Have 9,999 coins at once.

achievements.title: Ghost Buster
achievements.description: Obtain the Silph Scope from the Rocket Hideout.

achievements.description: Find every item and defeat every trainer in the Rocket Hideout.

achievements.description: Defeat Erika on Set Mode without using items in battle and without using Pokémon above level 29 at the beginning of the battle.

achievements.title: Sharing Is Caring
achievements.description: Obtain an Exp. All from Prof. Oak's aide in Fuchsia City.

achievements.title: Biggest Balls in Kanto

achievements.title: Enter the Dragon

achievements.description: Starting from the gym entrance, navigate through the Saffron City Gym using only 4 warps.

achievements.title: GB Bungaku Zenshuu
achievements.description: Without resetting and without leaving the building, read every journal in the Cinnabar Mansion.

achievements.title: Fiery Volcano Badge
achievements.description: Defeat Blaine and earn the Volcano Badge at Cinnabar Island.

achievements.title: Fire Fighter
achievements.description: Defeat Blaine on Set Mode without using items in battle and without using Pokémon above level 47 at the beginning of the battle.

achievements.title: 2000 IQ Super Quiz
achievements.description: Without resetting and without leaving the building, complete all of the quizzes in the Cinnabar Island Gym without fighting any trainers.

achievements.title: Feathered Earth Badge
achievements.description: Defeat Giovanni and earn the Earth Badge in Viridian City.

achievements.title: Blasting off Again
achievements.description: Defeat Giovanni in the Viridian Gym on Set Mode without using items in battle and without using Pokémon above level 50 at the beginning of the battle.

achievements.title: Spin to Lose
achievements.description: Starting from the gym entrance, navigate through the Viridian City Gym without using any spin tiles.

achievements.description: Find every item and defeat every trainer in Victory Road.

achievements.description: Beat the Elite Four and the Champion of the Pokémon League.

achievements.description: Without resetting, beat the Pokémon League with only one Pokémon in your party; it cannot be Mew or Mewtwo.

achievements.title: Brand Loyalty
achievements.description: Without resetting, beat the Pokémon League with a full party of Pokémon exclusive to Red.

achievements.title: Prof. Perfect
achievements.description: Without resetting, beat the Pokémon League without having any Pokémon faint and without using Pokémon above level 60 at the beginning of the League.

achievements.title: Smogon
achievements.description: Without resetting, beat the Pokémon League on Set Mode without using items in battle and without using Pokémon above level 50 at the beginning of the League.

achievements.title: The Sleeper Awakens
achievements.description: Use the Poké Flute to awaken and catch a Snorlax.

achievements.title: Uno, Dos, Tres!
achievements.description: Catch the three legendary birds.

achievements.title: The Strongest Pokémon Ever!
achievements.description: Catch the fabled Mewtwo.

achievements.title: Area Unknown
achievements.description: Without resetting and without leaving the cave, catch one of every Pokémon available in Cerulean Cave besides Mewtwo and fishing Pokémon without using the Master Ball.

achievements.title: A Fair Fight
achievements.description: Catch Mewtwo without using the Master Ball.

achievements.title: No Balls Necessary
achievements.description: Receive 6 Pokémon as gifts.

achievements.title: No ~Multi~ Set Required
achievements.description: Complete all 9 in-game trades.

achievements.title: This Is Illegal, You Know
achievements.description: In a single session, buy all of the Game Corner Pokémon.

achievements.title: Now It Is 100 Percent Safe

achievements.title: cOmPlEtElY dIfFeReNt GaMeS
achievements.description: Catch all of the Pokémon exclusive to Red version.

achievements.title: Gotta Catch 'em All
achievements.description: Catch all 124 Pokémon that are available in Red Version

achievements.title: Disk Collector
achievements.description: Find all 50 unmissable TMs and HMs on the overworld.

achievements.title: Disk Buyer
achievements.description: In a single session and without resetting, buy 1 of every TM possible from the Department Store and Game Corner.

achievements.title: Living Itemfinder
achievements.description: Find all unmissable items, including hidden items, on the overworld.

achievements.title: Genocide Route
achievements.description: Defeat all unmissable trainers in the Kanto region.

achievements.title: Preparing to Be the Very Best
achievements.description: Assemble a full team of Pokémon.

achievements.title: Anti-Darwinism
achievements.description: Prevent your Pokémon from evolving.

achievements.title: Halfway (Solo)
achievements.description: Get the Pokémon in Slot 1 from Level 49 to Level 50.

achievements.title: Halfway (Party)
achievements.description: In a party of five Pokémon of level 50 or greater, get your final Pokémon to level 50.

achievements.title: Gone Critical!
achievements.description: In a single battle, land five critical hits in a row.

achievements.title: Target Acquired
achievements.description: In a single battle, land five one-hit KO moves in a row.

achievements.title: Stalemate
achievements.description: Enter a battle with full HP and survive 20 turns without switching out or having either Pokémon take damage.

achievements.title: Surprise Mechanics
achievements.description: Use Metronome and go out with a bang!

achievements.title: I Found You, Faker!
achievements.description: As Ditto, use Transform on another Ditto.

achievements.title: Lawn Mower
achievements.description: Cut the grass.
